title: Static finite-support multi-character double-commutator envelope
question: Can the static single-character estimate be extended to a fixed finite-support configuration character with an explicit support-size envelope?

model.scope: Registered finite periodic Q3 volumes at fixed beta, compact sources, a fixed finite support S and real configuration-character amplitudes; no product-core density or history promotion.
model.commuting_reason: The P_x=p_x+a_x/2 commute for distinct sites, and all F_x and W_aS are configuration functions; scalar fourth-power and L2 triangle inequalities therefore apply in the declared finite support.
model.support_cost: The kinetic envelope carries |S|^3 and the force envelope carries the squared l1 amplitude norm; these costs are explicit and not hidden in a volume-uniform product claim.

scope.no_overclaim: This closes a static bound for each declared finite support and amplitude vector only. It does not prove a support-uniform product class, density, split-history bound, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, OS/KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The second commutator is formed with Q_plus=sum a_x(p_x+a_x/2)/(chi*hbar); cross-site P_x commute and no same-site cross term is introduced.
|sum_x c_x u_x|^4<=|S|^3 sum_x |c_x|^4|u_x|^4 is applied only to the commuting spectral variables.
All F_x and W_aS commute as configuration functions, so both two-sided products reduce to the same force L2 moment.
|S|^3 and the l1 amplitude cost are displayed explicitly; no hidden support-uniform or volume-uniform product assertion is made.
G_force4 is inherited only from the registered compact-source endpoint bridge and local force grid.
The final envelope uses the seminorm triangle inequality and assumes no kinetic/force orthogonality.
The static multi-character envelope is not applied to evolved split histories or factorial expansions.
R253 checks rational fixture arithmetic and support costs, not unbounded domains or limits.
Product-core density, direct D/delta-D, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed finite-support multi-character has an explicit static two-sided Gibbs-seminorm envelope in the registered finite periodic compact-source scope.
qft_interface.open: Support-uniform product/core density, evolved-force history control, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-support static multi-character bound; not a product-class or dynamics completion.
next_action: Test whether the explicit support and l1 costs can be made compatible with a preregistered product/core class, while separately proving evolved-force and modular-domain estimates.
no_overclaim: This is a finite static QFT-facing multi-character interface only. It is not a product-core density theorem, complete Q3 dynamics proof, OS/KMS/GNS result, mass-gap proof, continuum result, C6/Sector-A/Pre-A result, TECT production map or Clay result.
